title: Phenotypes in the Knowledge Portals
bodyHtml:
The names given to phenotypes for genetic associations in the Knowledge Portals (KPs) follow those used by authors of the studies. Each phenotype has a descriptive name and an internal ID. Phenotypes are assigned to specific KPs by broad groups (e.g., "ANTHROPOMETRIC", "GLYCEMIC"). To see the phenotypes available in a specific KP, click on its name below. To see the phenotype groups available in a specific KP, click the Research Method tab.
